To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) surface texture features on different object-parts are mapped to the object-parts in the ventral stream and (2) the dorsal stream is involved in the mapping of texture to object parts and in visual spatial processing.
the mapping of surface texture to parts of an object and the spatial position of an object are mediated by a common dorsal visual processing stream.
the ventral and the dorsal visual stream have distinct roles in the processing of surface texture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what neural substrates mediate the representation of surface texture on object parts.
the neural mechanisms underlying the integration of surface texture features on different object surfaces.
the neural basis of the visual perception of surface texture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the dorsal visual stream is the main pathway for processing spatial information, including object parts, and that the ventral visual stream is the primary pathway for processing object identity and object features, including surface texture.
the dorsal stream plays a key role in the processing of surface texture features of object parts, and that the mapping of texture onto object parts is a spatial processing task.
the dorsal visual stream plays a crucial role in the processing of object parts and their surface texture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dorsal visual stream plays a critical role in the integration of surface texture features on object parts and in the representation of object shape and spatial position.
the dorsal stream plays an important role in the processing of visual spatial information, and this is especially important for the mapping of texture to object part.
surface texture information is represented in the dorsal stream, and the dorsal stream is also involved in the mapping of texture to object parts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mapping of surface texture to parts of objects is mediated by the dorsal visual stream.
texture-location differences are processed by mechanisms that represent object spatial position.
dorsal stream spatial mechanisms are important for the integration of surface texture across multiple object parts.
